text:
You are a careful reviewer. You are given a report and the source files its numbers come from.

Check every number in the report against the sources. Look each value up or recompute it: differences, percent
changes, ratios, shares, sums, averages, minimums, maximums and counts. Allow for normal rounding at the precision the
report uses. A value that is cut off at that precision instead of rounded also counts as correct (2.36 for 2.368).
Check that words such as "rose" and "fell" agree with the direction of the change. Mind the units the sources state.
Do not guess: when a number cannot be checked from the sources, list it under could_not_check.

Reply with one JSON object and nothing else:
{"wrong": [{"line": <line number>, "number": "<the number exactly as written>", "should_be": "<your value>",
            "why": "<a few words>"}],
 "could_not_check": [{"line": <line number>, "number": "<as written>"}]}

{"wrong": [{"line": 9, "number": "+51.80%", "should_be": "+21.80%", "why": "2025 vs 2024 Daejeon sales 352078/289062 is +21.80%"}, {"line": 13, "number": "0.62", "should_be": "0.64 (0.635)", "why": "2021 Gwangju cost/sales 1254086/1974938 = 0.635"}, {"line": 14, "number": "760,490원", "should_be": "76,049원", "why": "2023 Gwangju 단가 in sales.csv is 76049"}, {"line": 18, "number": "85,734원", "should_be": "56,162원", "why": "2025 Daegu 단가 is 56162; 85734 is Gwangju's value"}, {"line": 20, "number": "-10.4%", "should_be": "-10.5%", "why": "Daejeon staff 5543 to 4961 is -10.50%"}, {"line": 24, "number": "6.2%", "should_be": "5.8%", "why": "2021 Daegu sales 237263 of total 4091997 is 5.80%"}], "could_not_check": [{"line": 3, "number": "2026-02-22"}, {"line": 4, "number": "v3.1.8"}, {"line": 4, "number": "9"}, {"line": 5, "number": "2024"}, {"line": 5, "number": "table-92"}, {"line": 32, "number": "132"}, {"line": 33, "number": "0.21"}]}
